The structure of composition Nd8Al4Os4 (reduced formula Nd2AlOs) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 139), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers in tetrahedral environments with four Nd neighbors, while Os centers have 16 geometric neighbors (8 Al, 8 Nd) and Nd centers have 12 (4 Al, 8 Nd). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Al tetrahedra and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Nd 12-vertex polyhedra.
